newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Bancomext to cut rates on dollar loans.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Bancomext to cut rates on dollar loans.

text.p: Mexico's Foreign Trade Bank (Bancomext) said on Wednesday it would cut interest rates as of October 1 by up to 50 basis points on its dollar export credits.
A bank spokesman said after the cuts, 180-day credits would be charged the London Interbank Offered Rate (Libor) plus 750 basis points, while 10-year credits would pay Libor plus 500 basis points.
